acceptanceQualification: Sixteen route/theme/width cases have visual evidence within the stated full-page or visible-viewport scopes, after retaining and rejecting eight original failed captures. This does not certify every product feature or account flow.
reviewedChecks: Landing and release-history full-page layout including footer
Auth form visibility within replacement viewport
Original/replacement byte lengths, SHA256 and decoded image dimensions

capturedMetrics.scrollbarQualification: Captured content widths exclude the 10px browser scrollbar. Proof scroll widths fit the requested CSS width; no horizontal overflow inferred from the 10px difference.

remainingAcceptance: Signup policy response and form/error/retry states require a controlled reachable backend; deliberate CSP block cannot exercise them.
Sign-in, signup and invite submissions were not performed.
Auth footer below replacement visible viewport is not reviewed by those images.
Production website routing/cache, authenticated backend, mail delivery, packaged native apps, Mac hardware and multi-client/provider workflows require their separate evidence.
